instruction: Query the OQMD database for stable Li-Fe-O ternary compounds (element_set=Li,Fe,O AND ntypes=3), calculate the average delta_e and save the full list and average to 'C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\setup\output_result\oqmd\oqmd_task_19.txt'. Use the OQMD REST API directly with the `requests` library (endpoint: https://oqmd.org/oqmdapi/formationenergy), do NOT use qmpy_rester.
